verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Let the King of my heart be the mountain where I run
The fountain I drink from
Oh He is my song
Let the King of my heart be the shadow where I hide
The ransom for my life
Oh He is my song

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are good, good
Oh, oh

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Let the King of my heart be the wind inside my sails
The anchor in the waves
Oh He is my song
Let the King of my heart be the fire inside my veins
The echo of my days
Oh He is my song

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You're never going to let
Never going to let me down

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
When the night is holding on to me
God is holding on

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
We the redeemed of the Lord
Say that You're good
And Your mercy endures
